theorems.name: Submission.slicing_im_st_level_set_charts
theorems.statement: ∀ (P m : ℕ) (Φ : Eucl (m + 1) → Eucl P) (Ω : Set (Eucl (m + 1))) (h : Eucl (m + 1) → ℝ) (t : ℝ), IsOpen Ω → ContDiff ℝ 1 Φ → (∃ c : ℝ, 0 < c ∧ ∀ w ∈ Ω, ∀ w' ∈ Ω, c * ‖w - w'‖ ≤ ‖Φ w - Φ w'‖) → ContDiff ℝ 1 h → ∃ (Ψ : ℕ → Eucl m → Eucl P) (V : ℕ → Set (Eucl m)), (∀ i, IsOpen (V i)) ∧ (∀ i, ContDiff ℝ 1 (Ψ i)) ∧ (∀ i, ∃ K : ℝ≥0, LipschitzOnWith K (Ψ i) (V i)) ∧ (∀ i, ∃ c : ℝ, 0 < c ∧ ∀ v ∈ V i, ∀ v' ∈ V i, c * ‖v - v'‖ ≤ ‖Ψ i v - Ψ i v'‖) ∧ (∀ w ∈ Ω, h w = t → fderiv ℝ h w ≠ 0 → ∃ i, ∃ v ∈ V i, Ψ i v = Φ w) ∧ ∀ i, ∀ v ∈ V i, ∃ w ∈ Ω, h w = t ∧ Ψ i v = Φ w ∧ LinearMap.range (fderiv ℝ (Ψ i) v).toLinearMap = Submodule.map (fderiv ℝ Φ w).toLinearMap (LinearMap.ker (fderiv ℝ h w).toLinearMap)
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
